The Breaking Point#000.src: Speak to General Elix at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] in {p}.

The Breaking Point#001.src: ... Alright, let's see here... Private! Give me a report!
The Breaking Point#001.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#002.src: Sir, our readings are postive! Stablility is at {~}, and shows no sign of dropping.
The Breaking Point#002.dst: 长官，读数正常！稳定度保持在 {~}，没有下降的迹象。
The Breaking Point#002.speaker: Private Walder

The Breaking Point#004.src: Excellent. Keep an eye on everything, and let me know if something comes up. Now, I need to go find...-
The Breaking Point#004.dst: 很好。盯紧所有状况，有什么情况就通知我。现在，我得去找……
The Breaking Point#004.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#005.src: Hmph. And who exactly are you? This site is off-limits to civilians.
The Breaking Point#005.dst: 哼。你到底是谁？这个地方禁止平民进入。
The Breaking Point#005.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#006.src: Adventurer. Of course. Well, as it stands, we're doing rather dangerous work here. I'll have to ask you to-
The Breaking Point#006.dst: 冒险者。当然了。好吧，就现在的情况来说，我们在这里做的工作相当危险。我得请你——
The Breaking Point#006.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#007.src: ... The stabilizer? We're doing rather dangerous work here, keeping the thing beyond that cliff passive. So, I'll have to ask you to-
The Breaking Point#007.dst: ……稳定器？我们在这里做的工作相当危险，要让悬崖那头的东西保持平静。所以，我得请你——
The Breaking Point#007.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#008.src: General! Stability is dropping, and fast!
The Breaking Point#008.dst: 将军！稳定度正在下降，而且很快！
The Breaking Point#008.speaker: Private Walder

The Breaking Point#010.src: What?! Of all times for it to-
The Breaking Point#010.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#011.src: Urgh... Soldiers, follow protocol! Secure what you can, and leave what you can't! And- you! I haven't forgotten about you. As soon as this all cleans up, we'll-
The Breaking Point#011.dst: 呃……士兵们，按规程行事！能保住的保住，保不住的就放下！还有——你！我没忘了你。等这一切收拾好，我们再——
The Breaking Point#011.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#012.src: Gah! This damned Colossus! What I wouldn't give to...
The Breaking Point#012.dst: 可恶！这该死的巨像！我真想……
The Breaking Point#012.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#013.src: ... It's over. Walder! Survey the damages to our equipment! Morec! Take count of injuries around the base, make sure everyone's safe!
The Breaking Point#013.dst: ……结束了。Walder！检查我们设备的损坏情况！Morec！清点基地周围的伤员，确保大家都平安！
The Breaking Point#013.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#015.src: General! We came as soon as we could- we were down in the library and the exit co- Oh. Wow.
The Breaking Point#015.dst: 将军！我们尽快赶来了——我们刚才在下面的图书馆，出口被……噢。哇。

The Breaking Point#016.src: Well, Rhay, you're here now, yes? What do you think, can you fix it? We'll need to get it working before-
The Breaking Point#016.dst: 好了，Rhay，你现在人到了，是吧？你怎么看，修得好吗？我们得在——之前让它恢复运转
The Breaking Point#016.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#017.src: Can I- No, of course I can't fix it! Not on my own, especially since we don't have the proper equipment around here! Ugh, how long has it even been since last time?
The Breaking Point#017.dst: 我修得——不，我当然修不好！光靠我一个人不行，何况这里根本没有合适的设备！唉，距离上一次到底过了多久？
The Breaking Point#017.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#018.src: It has been... three days... give or take. Rhay... you know we can't keep-
The Breaking Point#018.dst: 已经过了……三天……左右。Rhay……你知道我们不能一直——

The Breaking Point#019.src: The stabilizer has been working so far, Ineos! It's some of the finest technology our province has had to offer, and it has been working!
The Breaking Point#019.dst: 稳定器到目前为止都有用，Ineos！那是我们行省拿得出手的最好的技术之一，而且它一直都有用！
The Breaking Point#019.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#020.src: Rhay, you know... as well as I do... that it is getting worse. The Protector is... growing resistant to... your machines. We need... a new plan.
The Breaking Point#020.dst: Rhay，你跟我……一样清楚……情况正在恶化。守护者……对你的机器……越来越有抵抗力了。我们需要……新的计划。
The Breaking Point#020.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#021.src: Yes, well, as soon as you come up with one, I'll be glad to hear it! But so far, you've barely gotten anything-
The Breaking Point#021.dst: 是啊，好，等你想出一个来，我很乐意听！可是到目前为止，你几乎什么都没——
The Breaking Point#021.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#024.src: ... Sorry. I'm sorry, I didn't mean that. General, to answer your question... The stabilizer itself is damaged, but you should have what's needed to repair it here.
The Breaking Point#024.dst: ……抱歉。对不起，我不是那个意思。将军，回答你的问题……稳定器本身受损了，但修理它需要的东西这里应该都有。
The Breaking Point#024.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#025.src: The issue is that the controls look like they're fried! And we don't have any replacement parts stored here. We'll have to travel back to Corkus, and...
The Breaking Point#025.dst: 问题是控制装置看起来烧坏了！而我们这里没有备用零件。我们得回 Corkus 一趟，然后……
The Breaking Point#025.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#026.src: ... Right. You. You're an adventurer, yes? And you appear to be well-equipped. Then you'll be traveling to Corkus with Rhay, and assist with whatever is needed there.
The Breaking Point#026.dst: ……好。你。你是冒险者，对吧？看你装备也挺齐全。那你就跟 Rhay 一起去 Corkus，那边需要什么就帮什么。
The Breaking Point#026.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#028.src: Wait, General-... Right. Alright. In that case... I'll give you time to prepare. We'll take the Hot Air Balloon to travel to Corkus, so I'll meet you there. We don't have any time to waste.
The Breaking Point#028.dst: 等等，将军——……好吧。行。既然这样……我给你时间准备。我们搭热气球去 Corkus，我在那边等你。我们一点时间都不能浪费。
The Breaking Point#028.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#029.src: And I will... return to the library. I trust... you will succeed... But we must... prepare for the... worst.
The Breaking Point#029.dst: 而我……会回图书馆去。我相信……你们会成功……但我们必须……做好……最坏的打算。
The Breaking Point#029.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#031.src: Meet Rhay at the Hot Air Balloon at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Breaking Point#031.dst: 到 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的热气球与 Rhay 会合

The Breaking Point#032.src: Ah, you're here! Well, if you're ready, then we'd best be off. Just hop aboard this balloon, and the captain will take us where we need to go.
The Breaking Point#032.dst: 啊，你来了！好，如果你准备好了，我们最好马上出发。跳上这个气球，船长会载我们去该去的地方。
The Breaking Point#032.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#033.src: I can tell you more while we travel, but we need to get going quick. There's no telling how much time we have before-
The Breaking Point#033.dst: 路上我可以再多跟你说一些，但我们得赶快走。谁也不知道在——之前我们还有多少时间
The Breaking Point#033.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#034.src: Right, right. Don't mind me, I'm just a little on edge, for... well, obvious reasons. Just hop aboard.
The Breaking Point#034.dst: 好，好。别在意我，我只是有点紧张，因为……嗯，原因很明显。上来吧。
The Breaking Point#034.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#035.src: Travel to {p} via the Hot Air Balloon at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Breaking Point#036.src: Well, there it is! The Canyon Colossus itself. The source of all our problems here at {p}.
The Breaking Point#036.dst: 看，就是那个！峡谷巨像本尊。我们在 {p} 所有麻烦的根源。
The Breaking Point#036.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#037.src: So! How much do you already know? I know we dragged you into this without telling you much, so... I can fill you in on the details.
The Breaking Point#037.dst: 那么！你已经知道多少了？我知道我们没跟你说什么就把你拖进来了，所以……我可以给你补充细节。
The Breaking Point#037.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#038.src: Oh, he did? Right, that makes sense. Well, you're right in that it's the source of the earthquakes, but there's more to it than that.
The Breaking Point#038.dst: 噢，他说了？对，说得通。嗯，你说得没错，它是地震的来源，但事情不只如此。
The Breaking Point#038.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#039.src: You've seen the {p}, right? Heard of the Fracturing. From what I can tell, what happened to that region a thousand years ago is happening again, here and now.
The Breaking Point#039.dst: 你见过 {p} 了吧？听说过大碎裂。据我所知，一千年前发生在那片地区的事，此时此地正在重演。
The Breaking Point#039.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#040.src: Yes, exactly. It's been malfunctioning for a long time now, and it's starting to tear the canyon apart. That's where we come in.
The Breaking Point#040.dst: 对，没错。它已经失常很久了，现在开始把峡谷撕裂。这就是我们出场的原因。
The Breaking Point#040.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#041.src: Well... To start with, it's an ancient thing. It was built long before even the doguns can remember, and they've lived in this region for thousands of years.
The Breaking Point#041.dst: 嗯……首先，它是很古老的东西。连 Dogun 都记不得它是什么时候造的，而他们在这片地区已经住了几千年。
The Breaking Point#041.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#042.src: According to Ineos, the doguns used to be responsible for keeping it calm, but ever since the dwarves came in and started their war, that knowledge has been lost to time.
The Breaking Point#042.dst: 照 Ineos 的说法，以前是 Dogun 负责让它保持平静，但自从矮人来了、打起那场战争，那份知识就失传了。
The Breaking Point#042.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#043.src: Which is... a problem! {p} has been malfunctioning for hundreds of years, and it's reaching its breaking point. If we don't stop it, it'll tear the canyon apart.
The Breaking Point#043.dst: 这就……是个问题！{p} 已经失常几百年了，现在快到崩溃边缘了。如果我们不阻止它，它会把峡谷撕成碎片。
The Breaking Point#043.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#044.src: Oh? So you've traveled the canyon, then. Yeah, then you've seen how the canyon twists and changes.
The Breaking Point#044.dst: 噢？所以你已经走过峡谷了。是啊，那你应该见过峡谷是怎么扭曲变形的。
The Breaking Point#044.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#045.src: It destroys peoples' homes, it traps them deep within the maze-like valleys... And, more recently, it has been tearing a hole into the void.
The Breaking Point#045.dst: 它毁掉人们的家园，把他们困在迷宫般的深谷里……而最近，它更是撕开了一个通往虚空的洞。
The Breaking Point#045.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#046.src: This thing is ancient, and we don't know how it works. The best we can do is try to keep it from reaching its breaking point, and prevent the canyon from meeting the same fate as the {p}.
The Breaking Point#046.dst: 这东西非常古老，我们也不知道它是怎么运作的。我们能做的，只有尽量不让它到达崩溃边缘，免得峡谷落得跟 {p} 一样的下场。
The Breaking Point#046.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#047.src: So, Gavel's government contacted us in Corkus some time ago, requesting our help to deal with this threat.
The Breaking Point#047.dst: 所以，不久前 Gavel 政府联系了我们 Corkus，请我们帮忙对付这个威胁。
The Breaking Point#047.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#048.src: Our council agreed, and we got to work designing a machine that could replicate the dogun magic that pacified that Colossus long ago.
The Breaking Point#048.dst: 我们的议会同意了，我们就着手设计一台机器，复制很久以前平息那座巨像的 Dogun 魔法。
The Breaking Point#048.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#049.src: We've had Ineos' help on that front. He and I have been working here in {p} to ensure things are running smoothly. Which... evidently, they are not.
The Breaking Point#049.dst: 这方面有 Ineos 帮忙。我和他一直在 {p} 这里工作，确保一切运转顺利。而……显然，现在并不顺利。
The Breaking Point#049.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#050.src: ... We'll be fine! We're going to meet up with my husband at Corkus, and he'll know what to do. He always does.
The Breaking Point#050.dst: ……我们会没事的！我们要去 Corkus 跟我丈夫会合，他会知道该怎么办。他一向都知道。
The Breaking Point#050.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#051.src: Our people there will be able to get us the parts we need to repair the device. This... this isn't the first it's exploded. I had hoped that this time we would have gotten it stable, but...
The Breaking Point#051.dst: 那边的人能帮我们弄到修理装置需要的零件。这……这不是它第一次爆炸了。我原本希望这次能让它稳定下来，可是……
The Breaking Point#051.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#052.src: But, hey! We have it under control. We're always able to repair it quickly enough to keep it running while the Colossus is active.
The Breaking Point#052.dst: 不过，嘿！我们控制得住。我们每次都能及时修好它，让它在巨像活跃的时候保持运转。
The Breaking Point#052.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#053.src: Oh! Yeah. He's the one responsible for the design and production of this device. He's got a talent for designing these sorts of things, without him... well, we'd be in a much worse situation than we are now.
The Breaking Point#053.dst: 噢！对。这台装置就是他负责设计和制造的。他很有设计这类东西的天分，要是没有他……嗯，我们的处境会比现在糟得多。
The Breaking Point#053.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#054.src: I'll be glad to see him again. It's been a while since I last had to travel to Corkus, and... Well, I'm confident he'll know what to do here. He always does.
The Breaking Point#054.dst: 能再见到他我会很高兴。我已经好一阵子没去 Corkus 了，而且……嗯，我相信他会知道这里该怎么办。他一向都知道。
The Breaking Point#054.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#055.src: ... Right! Hey, it looks like we're almost there. We'll be able to get this all sorted out, and we'll be back to {p} in no time.
The Breaking Point#055.dst: ……对！嘿，看来我们快到了。我们能把这一切处理好，很快就能回到 {p}。
The Breaking Point#055.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#056.src: Find the contact in the factory at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Breaking Point#056.dst: 到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的工厂里找到联络人

The Breaking Point#057.src: Alright, let's just head on in. My husband should be around here somewhere...
The Breaking Point#057.dst: 好，我们直接进去吧。我丈夫应该就在这附近……
The Breaking Point#057.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#058.src: Rhay, love! You're back already? Our next routine maitenance isn't for another- Wait, {u}? What are you doing here?
The Breaking Point#058.dst: Rhay，亲爱的！你已经回来啦？下一次例行维护还要再过——等等，{u}？你怎么会在这里？
The Breaking Point#058.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#059.src: I... You two know each other?
The Breaking Point#059.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#060.src: Of course we do - they're the one who helped me with all the Factory stuff! How did you two meet?
The Breaking Point#060.dst: 当然认识——工厂那些事就是他们帮我的！你们两个是怎么认识的？
The Breaking Point#060.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#061.src: They just showed up at {p} and agreed to help us with... - Why didn't you bring this up earlier?
The Breaking Point#061.dst: 他们就这么出现在 {p}，答应帮我们……——你之前怎么不提？
The Breaking Point#061.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#062.src: It must have...- right. Well, if anything that makes you even more qualified to help us out, I guess! I can't believe I didn't recognize you...?
The Breaking Point#062.dst: 那一定是……——好吧。嗯，要说有什么，那就是你更有资格帮我们了吧！真不敢相信我居然没认出你……？
The Breaking Point#062.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#063.src: Okay, right, back to the question - what are you two doing here already? There's another few days or so until our next routine maitenance, isn't there?
The Breaking Point#063.dst: 好，好，回到正题——你们两个怎么这么快就来了？离下一次例行维护还有几天吧？
The Breaking Point#063.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#064.src: I did send you an invite! I gave it to... you know, that that one captain who ferries people around! But then you didn't show up to the wedding, so I guess it didn't reach you...
The Breaking Point#064.dst: 我有寄邀请函给你！我交给了……你知道的，那个那个载人来回的船长！可是你没来参加婚礼，所以我猜没送到你手上……
The Breaking Point#064.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#065.src: Look, you're a hard person to reach! You've been all over the world at this point, including {p} of all places- speaking of, why are you two here?
The Breaking Point#065.dst: 听着，你这个人很难联系上！你现在已经跑遍全世界了，连 {p} 都去过——说到这个，你们两个到底来干嘛？
The Breaking Point#065.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#067.src: Right! Right. Got a little distracted there... Uh, we've run into a problem back at {p}. We experienced an undetected seismic event, and the device was heavily damaged.
The Breaking Point#067.dst: 对！对。刚才有点分心了……呃，我们在 {p} 那边遇到麻烦了。发生了一次没被侦测到的地震，装置严重受损。
The Breaking Point#067.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#068.src: We should be able to finish most of the repairs with what materials we have there, but we're missing a Magmaflux Capacitor for the control panel.
The Breaking Point#068.dst: 大部分的修理用那边现有的材料应该就能完成，但控制面板还缺一个熔流电容器。
The Breaking Point#068.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#069.src: ... Oh. That's going to be a problem. We haven't had an opportunity to make more parts yet - it hasn't been long enough since our last maitenance. So... I'm not sure what we-
The Breaking Point#069.dst: ……噢。那就麻烦了。我们还没机会做更多零件——离上次维护还没过多久。所以……我不确定我们——
The Breaking Point#069.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#070.src: I overheard the conversation from over there- good to see you Rhay, by the way- But. We may not have any capacitors left up here, but I know where you can get one.
The Breaking Point#070.dst: 我在那边听到你们的对话了——顺便说一句，很高兴见到你，Rhay——不过。我们这上面也许没有电容器了，但我知道哪里弄得到。
The Breaking Point#070.speaker: Nodise

The Breaking Point#071.src: We repurposed this factory for our needs, but it was built here to process resources from the mines below.
The Breaking Point#071.dst: 我们把这座工厂改成自己用，但它原本是建来处理下面矿坑挖出的资源的。
The Breaking Point#071.speaker: Nodise

The Breaking Point#072.src: Though it was discontinued, it's still very likely that there are still miner mechs down there- and some of the more powerful models made use of very similar circuits to the capacitors we use today.
The Breaking Point#072.dst: 虽然已经停用了，但下面很可能还有采矿机甲——而其中一些比较强的型号，用的电路跟我们现在的电容器非常相似。
The Breaking Point#072.speaker: Nodise

The Breaking Point#073.src: ... You're right! If they're still down there, we should be able to scrap one of the bots and reuse its circuits. {u}, we can send you down into the mines to find what we need, while we prepare up here!
The Breaking Point#073.dst: ……你说得对！如果它们还在下面，我们应该能拆掉一台机器人，重复利用它的电路。{u}，我们可以派你下矿坑去找需要的东西，我们在上面做准备！
The Breaking Point#073.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#074.src: Alright... Good luck down there! Find the bot, destroy it, and bring the capacitor back up! Just step on the platform in the middle of the factory when you're ready.
The Breaking Point#074.dst: 好吧……下去之后祝你好运！找到机器人，摧毁它，把电容器带上来！准备好了就踩上工厂中央的平台。
The Breaking Point#074.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#075.src: Okay. That's fine, just make it quick! You know we can't waste any time here.
The Breaking Point#075.dst: 好。那没问题，只是动作要快！你知道我们这里一点时间都不能浪费。
The Breaking Point#075.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#076.src: Retrieve the part from the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Breaking Point#080.dst: 侦测到入侵者。已授权敌对交战。
The Breaking Point#080.speaker: Mining Robots

The Breaking Point#082.src: DIVERTING ALL AVAILABLE UNITS TO HALT INTRUDER.
The Breaking Point#082.dst: 调派所有可用单位阻止入侵者。
The Breaking Point#082.speaker: Mining Robots

The Breaking Point#083.src: THIS IS A RESTRICTED AREA. REQUESTING AUTHORISATION FOR USE OF LETHAL FORCE AGAINST INTRUDER...
The Breaking Point#083.dst: 此处为禁区。请求授权对入侵者使用致命武力。
The Breaking Point#083.speaker: The Mother Drill

The Breaking Point#085.src: DIVERTING MINER MECHS TO HALT INTRUDER.
The Breaking Point#085.dst: 调派采矿机甲阻止入侵者。
The Breaking Point#085.speaker: The Mother Drill

The Breaking Point#086.src: Return to the hot air balloon at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with the Magmaflux Capacitor.
The Breaking Point#086.dst: 带着熔流电容器回到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的热气球。

The Breaking Point#087.src: Amazing work! I'll get us back to {p} with that capacitor as quick as possible.
The Breaking Point#087.dst: 干得漂亮！我会尽快带着这个电容器回到 {p}。
The Breaking Point#087.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#088.src: Good to see you again, {u}. Good luck with the colossus. And Rhay... come home as soon as you can.
The Breaking Point#088.dst: 很高兴又见到你，{u}。祝你对付巨像顺利。还有 Rhay……尽早回家。
The Breaking Point#088.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#090.src: Return to General Elix with the Corkian Stabiliser
The Breaking Point#090.dst: 带着 Corkus 稳定器回到 Elix 将军那里

The Breaking Point#091.src: Well... that went better than expected, really. I still can't believe you didn't tell me you already knew Maxie.
The Breaking Point#091.dst: 嗯……说真的，比预想的顺利。我还是不敢相信你没告诉我你早就认识 Maxie。
The Breaking Point#091.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#092.src: Oh, wow. It looks like they've managed to fix up the machine pretty well, all things considered. Just this part left to get it running again...
The Breaking Point#092.dst: 噢，哇。考虑到各种情况，他们把机器修得相当不错了。只剩这个零件就能让它重新运转……
The Breaking Point#092.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#093.src: Hmph. Rhay, there you are. Seeing as you've returned, I gather everything went smoothly at Corkus?
The Breaking Point#093.dst: 哼。Rhay，你来了。既然你回来了，我想 Corkus 那边一切顺利吧？
The Breaking Point#093.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#094.src: Smoothly enough, General! We have what we need to repair the control panel. We'll be able to get the stabilizer running again!
The Breaking Point#094.dst: 还算顺利，将军！修理控制面板需要的东西我们都拿到了。我们能让稳定器重新运转！
The Breaking Point#094.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#095.src: Well?! What are you waiting for? Finish the repairs, we can't afford to lose any time with this damned Colossus looming over us.
The Breaking Point#095.dst: 那还等什么？！赶快修完，这该死的巨像压在我们头上，我们一点时间都耽误不起。
The Breaking Point#095.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#096.src: Yes, sir! Alright. {u}, just slot the capacitor in right... there. I'll make sure it runs smoothly.
The Breaking Point#096.dst: 是，长官！好。{u}，把电容器插在……那里就行。我会确保它运转顺利。
The Breaking Point#096.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#097.src: There we are. Now, let's get this thing running again! Walder, keep an eye on stability! And... Rhay. You're confident this will work?
The Breaking Point#097.dst: 好了。现在，让这东西重新运转吧！Walder，盯着稳定度！还有……Rhay。你有把握这会成功？
The Breaking Point#097.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#098.src: I-I'm sure. This is our last chance. We have to hold out hope that the stabilizer will hold.
The Breaking Point#098.dst: 我、我有把握。这是我们最后的机会。我们只能抱着希望，相信稳定器撑得住。
The Breaking Point#098.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#099.src: Alright, alright... It's now or never... Hold, stabilizer, hold!
The Breaking Point#099.dst: 好，好……成败在此一举……撑住，稳定器，撑住！
The Breaking Point#099.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#100.src: ... Oh. That's... that's it, then. It's over. We failed.
The Breaking Point#100.dst: ……噢。那……那就这样了。结束了。我们失败了。
The Breaking Point#100.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#101.src: I... am sorry, Rhay. I had... hoped it would work. In truth... I do not have... a plan... either.
The Breaking Point#101.dst: 我……很抱歉，Rhay。我原本……希望它会成功。老实说……我也……没有……计划。
The Breaking Point#101.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#102.src: The Elders... would have known... what to do... But they are... long gone. Nothing but... ruins remain.
The Breaking Point#102.dst: 长老们……会知道……该怎么办……但他们……早已不在了。只剩下……废墟。
The Breaking Point#102.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#103.src: The Elders... They were... the greatest... of doguns. As old... as the oldest stones... and wise... as the earth itself...
The Breaking Point#103.dst: 长老们……他们是……Dogun 之中……最伟大的。古老得……如同最古老的岩石……睿智得……如同大地本身……
The Breaking Point#103.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#104.src: They were capable... of magic... beyond what any... of us could achieve. They alone... could calm our... Protector.
The Breaking Point#104.dst: 他们能施展……我们任何人……都做不到的……魔法。只有他们……能平息我们的……守护者。
The Breaking Point#104.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#105.src: They were... sealed away. Frozen in... the deepest... of ice. When the dwarves... slew Garaheth... the Elders... fell with him.
The Breaking Point#105.dst: 他们被……封印了。冻结在……最深的……冰里。当矮人……杀死 Garaheth 时……长老们……也随他一同陨落。
The Breaking Point#105.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#106.src: Such atrocities... The war... My people... But it is not... to dwell on, now. There are... more important... things at hand.
The Breaking Point#106.dst: 那些暴行……那场战争……我的族人……但现在不是……沉湎的时候。眼前有……更重要的……事。
The Breaking Point#106.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#107.src: I... I did not... know of this. My people... are free? How long... has it been... since I have seen... my home?
The Breaking Point#107.dst: 我……我并不……知道这件事。我的族人……自由了？距离我……上一次见到……我的家园……已经过了……多久？
The Breaking Point#107.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#108.src: You... Adventurer. We must... speak to my people. Our chieftain... will know... how we may free... the Elders.
The Breaking Point#108.dst: 你……冒险者。我们必须……去找我的族人谈谈。我们的酋长……会知道……该如何解放……长老们。
The Breaking Point#108.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#109.src: If there's a chance... We have to take it. Ineos, {u}, take the balloon. We'll do what we can here. Now, go! There's no time to waste!
The Breaking Point#109.dst: 只要还有一丝机会……我们就必须抓住。Ineos、{u}，你们乘气球去。我们会在这里尽力而为。快去！没有时间可浪费了！
The Breaking Point#109.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#110.src: Meet Ineos and Rhay at the Hot Air Balloon at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Breaking Point#110.dst: 到 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的热气球与 Ineos 和 Rhay 会合。

The Breaking Point#111.src: I have never... seen the Heights... from above. I wonder... if their glow... holds the same strength... it does from below...
The Breaking Point#111.dst: 我从来没有……从上方……看过高地。不知道……它的光芒……从上面看……是否跟从下面看……一样强烈……
The Breaking Point#111.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#112.src: I only hope... the Elders... are not gone... for good. We greatly need... their wisdom.
The Breaking Point#112.dst: 我只希望……长老们……没有……永远离去。我们非常需要……他们的智慧。
The Breaking Point#112.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#113.src: Ah... I believe us... to be landing...
The Breaking Point#113.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#114.src: Travel to {p} with Ineos via the Hot Air Balloon at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Breaking Point#114.dst: 与 Ineos 一起搭乘 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的热气球前往 {p}

The Breaking Point#115.src: ... Hello. What a... strange sight... to see you landing... at our village... in such a contraption...
The Breaking Point#115.dst: ……你好。真是……奇怪的景象……看到你们乘着……这种玩意儿……降落在……我们村子……
The Breaking Point#115.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#116.src: And... is that... Ineos? We thought... the dwarves... had turned you into rubble...
The Breaking Point#116.dst: 还有……那是……Ineos 吗？我们以为……矮人……已经把你变成碎石了……
The Breaking Point#116.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#117.src: I escaped... It is a long... story, Korzim. We do not... have time. Where is... your father?
The Breaking Point#117.dst: 我逃出来了……说来话长，Korzim。我们没有……时间了。你的……父亲在哪？
The Breaking Point#117.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#118.src: He is... below. They are... freeing the frozen... in New Taloka. Why do you... wish to speak... with him?
The Breaking Point#118.dst: 他在……下面。他们正在……新 Taloka……解放被冰封的族人。你为什么……想跟他……说话？
The Breaking Point#118.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#119.src: The Protector... is angered. We must find... the Elders. They will know... how to calm it.
The Breaking Point#119.dst: 守护者……被激怒了。我们必须找到……长老们。他们会知道……如何平息它。
The Breaking Point#119.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#120.src: The... Protector... I understand. I will... bring you two... to him. Sidio... Raetin... I leave you two... in charge.
The Breaking Point#120.dst: 守护者……我明白了。我会……带你们两个……去见他。Sidio……Raetin……这里就交给……你们两个了。
The Breaking Point#120.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#121.src: Now, let us travel... through flame... and through stone...
The Breaking Point#121.dst: 现在，让我们……出发吧。穿过火焰……穿过岩石……
The Breaking Point#121.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#122.src: Speak to {p}'s King and the Dogun Chieftain at New Taloka at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Breaking Point#122.dst: 到 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的新 Taloka 与 {p} 的国王和 Dogun 酋长交谈

The Breaking Point#123.src: We are... here. Taloka was... one of the first to fall... in the war. We have been... working with the dwarves... to restore it.
The Breaking Point#123.dst: 我们……到了。Taloka 是……战争中……最早陷落的地方之一。我们一直在……和矮人……合作重建它。
The Breaking Point#123.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#127.src: Very well. Begin on three. One... Two... Three!
The Breaking Point#127.dst: 很好。数到三开始。一……二……三！
The Breaking Point#127.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#128.src: Beginning reheating cycle! Stand back from the subject.
The Breaking Point#128.dst: 开始回温循环！请远离对象。
The Breaking Point#128.speaker: Dwarven Technician

The Breaking Point#129.src: ... Where... am... I? How long... has it... been...?
The Breaking Point#129.speaker: Unsealed Dogun

The Breaking Point#130.src: ...Dwarf... You... you froze me... I will... I will...!
The Breaking Point#130.dst: ……矮人……你……你冻住了我……我要……我要……！
The Breaking Point#130.speaker: Unsealed Dogun

The Breaking Point#131.src: Calm yourself... Delg. Our war... has ended. We are... freed. You have been... freed.
The Breaking Point#131.dst: 冷静下来……Delg。我们的战争……已经结束了。我们……自由了。你已经……获得自由了。
The Breaking Point#131.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#132.src: ... Freedom? Hundreds... of years... of war... And we are... free?
The Breaking Point#132.dst: ……自由？几百年……的战争……而我们……自由了？
The Breaking Point#132.speaker: Dogun Delg

The Breaking Point#133.src: Yes. We are free... to roam our home... once more. Edac... Escort Delg... and help him re-adjust... to the heights.
The Breaking Point#133.dst: 是的。我们可以……再次自由地……漫游我们的家园。Edac……护送 Delg……帮他重新适应……高地。
The Breaking Point#133.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#134.src: Ah, {u}! It's good to see you again. We haven't seen you around here since... since the end of it.
The Breaking Point#134.dst: 啊，{u}！真高兴又见到你。自从……自从那一切结束之后，我们就没在这附近见过你了。
The Breaking Point#134.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#135.src: Yes. We have been... hard at work... these past weeks. Taloka will soon... stand once more. And many... of our sealed bretheren... have been returned to life.
The Breaking Point#135.dst: 是的。这几个星期……我们一直……在努力工作。Taloka 很快……就会重新屹立。许多……被封印的同胞……也已经重获生命。
The Breaking Point#135.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#136.src: Ah, but we can talk more about that later. Tell me, what brings you here today? Is there something you need from us?
The Breaking Point#136.dst: 啊，不过这些我们晚点再聊。告诉我，今天是什么风把你吹来了？需要我们帮什么忙吗？
The Breaking Point#136.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#137.src: The situtation... is dire. The Great Protector... has been left alone... for far too long. We need... the wisdom... of our Elders. Do you know... where they are sealed?
The Breaking Point#137.dst: 情况……非常危急。伟大的守护者……被放着不管……太久了。我们需要……长老们的……智慧。你们知道……他们被封印在哪里吗？
The Breaking Point#137.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#138.src: The Elders?! Yes, we know where they are sealed. However, retrieving them is no simple task. It would take us years to break past the defenses, and we have countless other doguns to release first.
The Breaking Point#138.dst: 长老？！是的，我们知道他们被封印在哪。但是，要把他们救出来可不简单。突破那些防御要花上好几年，而我们还有无数其他 Dogun 要先解放。
The Breaking Point#138.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#140.src: Ineos... I want our Elders free... as much as you do. But our Protector... has stood firm... for hundreds of years. It can stand... for another-
The Breaking Point#140.dst: Ineos……我跟你一样……希望长老们……获得自由。但我们的守护者……已经屹立了……几百年。它还能……再撑——
The Breaking Point#140.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#141.src: No... Has it truly... fallen this far..?
The Breaking Point#141.dst: 不……难道它真的……已经恶化到这种地步……？
The Breaking Point#141.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#142.src: ... That was your Protector? How powerful is it, if it can reach this far?
The Breaking Point#142.dst: ……那就是你们的守护者？连这么远都能波及到，它到底有多强？
The Breaking Point#142.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#143.src: If the Protector... could shake even the Heights... It could destroy... half of this province.
The Breaking Point#143.dst: 如果守护者……连高地都能撼动……它就能摧毁……半个行省。
The Breaking Point#143.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#144.src: Draani... the Elders must be freed. They alone... would know how to calm it.
The Breaking Point#144.dst: Draani……长老们必须获得解放。只有他们……知道如何平息它。
The Breaking Point#144.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#145.src: Yes... I understand. Very well. {u}, I will take you to the Elders' vault. I hold the keys to open the way forward. Paku, gather your people. See if anyone has alternative solutions.
The Breaking Point#145.dst: 是的……我明白了。很好。{u}，我带你去长老们的地窖。开路的钥匙在我手上。Paku，召集你的族人。看看有没有人有别的办法。
The Breaking Point#145.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#146.src: We will... search for one. I cannot... promise that one exists.
The Breaking Point#146.dst: 我们会……去找找看。我无法……保证真的有办法。
The Breaking Point#146.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#147.src: {u}, let us go. It sounds as if we have very little time to waste.
The Breaking Point#147.dst: {u}，我们走吧。听起来我们没多少时间可浪费了。
The Breaking Point#147.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#148.src: I will make preparations, and meet you at the Vault of Ice.
The Breaking Point#148.dst: 我去做些准备，在冰之地窖跟你会合。
The Breaking Point#148.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#149.src: Enter the Dogun Vault within the lower Freezing Heights at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Breaking Point#149.dst: 进入冰冻高地下层 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Dogun 地窖

The Breaking Point#150.src: ... Ahem. This is the entrance, then. One of our most closely guarded secrets... I was hoping not to have to confront this reminder for a while yet...
The Breaking Point#150.dst: ……咳咳。那么，这就是入口了。我们守得最严的秘密之一……我原本希望还能再过一阵子才需要面对这个提醒……
The Breaking Point#150.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#151.src: But it seems we don't have much choice now. I have the keys, let's go inside.
The Breaking Point#151.dst: 但看来我们现在没什么选择了。钥匙在我这，我们进去吧。
The Breaking Point#151.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#152.src: Unlock the Dogun Vault to find the Elders.
The Breaking Point#152.dst: 解锁 Dogun 地窖，找到长老们。

The Breaking Point#153.src: Rather cold in here, isn't it? A vault carved into a drake's True Ice... I suppose my ancestors hoped to seal these doguns in here forever. I'll be glad to disappoint them.
The Breaking Point#153.dst: 这里面挺冷的，是吧？一座凿进飞龙真冰里的地窖……我想我的祖先是希望把这些 Dogun 永远封在这里。我很乐意让他们失望。
The Breaking Point#153.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#154.src: Quickly, then, let us proceed to the primary door. I pray the Elders will be responsive to our situation with the Colossus.
The Breaking Point#154.dst: 那么，我们赶快往主门去吧。祈祷长老们会愿意理会我们巨像这件事。
The Breaking Point#154.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#155.src: In any case... Let me see if I can open this second gate. It should be as simple as...
The Breaking Point#155.dst: 总之……我看看能不能打开第二道门。应该只要……
The Breaking Point#155.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#156.src: Hm. That... didn't work. This magic is old, and I have never took the time to learn it properly... Alright. We have alternatives.
The Breaking Point#156.dst: 嗯。那……没用。这魔法很古老，我从来没花时间好好学过……好吧。我们还有别的办法。
The Breaking Point#156.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#157.src: If my memory serves correctly, there should be a manual override on the other side of this chasm.
The Breaking Point#157.dst: 如果我没记错，这道深渊的另一边应该有个手动控制开关。
The Breaking Point#157.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#158.src: The issue is that treacherous pool of lava on the way... and I don't think my knees are up to the task of jumping over it all.
The Breaking Point#158.dst: 问题是路上有一池凶险的熔岩……而我觉得我的膝盖撑不住跳过去。
The Breaking Point#158.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#159.src: I would never usually do this, but these are desperate times. Here, take my Trusty Grappling Hook. It should help you get over to the switch.
The Breaking Point#159.dst: 我平常绝对不会这么做，但现在是非常时期。来，拿着我的可靠抓钩。它应该能帮你到开关那边。
The Breaking Point#159.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#160.src: It has limitations, though. It will only be able to latch onto those blue rocks on the walls - and I'll be taking it back once you're finished, thank you very much!
The Breaking Point#160.dst: 不过它有限制。它只能勾住墙上那些蓝色的石头——而且等你用完我可是要收回来的，谢谢配合！
The Breaking Point#160.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#161.src: Hey, {u}! Looks like you're doing good so far, but if you get stuck remember you can jump and then grapple mid-air, that might help on some of those trickier platforms!
The Breaking Point#161.dst: 嘿，{u}！看来你到目前为止都做得不错，不过要是卡住了，记得你可以跳起来再在半空中甩钩，某些比较难的平台也许用得上！
The Breaking Point#161.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#162.src: Looks like that unlocked it, {u}! Get yourself back over here and I'll open the door.
The Breaking Point#162.dst: 看来解锁了，{u}！回到我这边来，我来开门。
The Breaking Point#162.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#163.src: There we are! Excellent work. You used that hook like a true expert! Ah, reminds me of the time-...
The Breaking Point#163.dst: 好了！干得漂亮。你用那钩子就像个真正的行家！啊，让我想起那一次……
The Breaking Point#163.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#164.src: ...Ahem. Excellent work, indeed. With the override activated, I should be able to do the rest of the work to open the gate.
The Breaking Point#164.dst: ……咳咳。干得确实漂亮。手动控制已经启动，剩下开门的工作我应该能自己完成。
The Breaking Point#164.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#165.src: First, though, I'll be having that grappling hook back! Think of what could happen if you had free reign of that all over.
The Breaking Point#165.dst: 不过首先，那个抓钩我要收回来了！想想看，要是让你拿着它到处乱跑会发生什么事。
The Breaking Point#165.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#166.src: And so... I believe we have gone as far as we can.
The Breaking Point#166.dst: 那么……我想我们已经走到尽头了。
The Breaking Point#166.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#167.src: This is True Ice, {u}. It has scarred this part of the Heights for centuries, ever since it was created by an ice dragon in my ancestors' conquest.
The Breaking Point#167.dst: 这是真冰，{u}。几百年来，自从我的祖先征战时一条冰龙造出了它，它就一直在高地的这一带留下疤痕。
The Breaking Point#167.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#168.src: It cannot be melted or burned through by any means. It is why this location was chosen for their tomb. I'm afraid there is nothing more we can do.
The Breaking Point#168.dst: 它用任何方法都无法融化或烧穿。这就是为什么这里被选作他们的墓穴。恐怕我们无能为力了。
The Breaking Point#168.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#169.src: At the end of the war, I imagine.
The Breaking Point#169.dst: 我想是在战争结束的时候。
The Breaking Point#169.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#170.src: As the final dogun settlements fell, and as Garaheth was slain for the first time, my ancestors must have sealed them deep in this ice.
The Breaking Point#170.dst: 当最后的 Dogun 聚落陷落、Garaheth 第一次被杀的时候，我的祖先一定是把他们封进了这冰的深处。
The Breaking Point#170.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#171.src: The... actions of the Dwarves after winning the war are well documented. I would not be surprised if our accounts describe this imprisonment as a great victory.
The Breaking Point#171.dst: 矮人赢得战争之后的……所作所为都有详细记载。如果我们的史书把这次囚禁描述成一场伟大的胜利，我也不会意外。
The Breaking Point#171.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#172.src: The Dwarves, of course. Who else?
The Breaking Point#172.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#173.src: I believe it was General Algard of the Dwarven army to order the Elders' imprisonments.
The Breaking Point#173.dst: 我记得是矮人军队的 Algard 将军下令囚禁长老们的。
The Breaking Point#173.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#174.src: He was lauded as a hero, naturally. Now... we must reap the consequences of such a decision.
The Breaking Point#174.dst: 他自然被歌颂为英雄。而现在……我们必须承担那个决定的后果。
The Breaking Point#174.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#175.src: True Ice is a material that cannot be melted or burned through by any means. Not even dogun magic has been able to make a dent.
The Breaking Point#175.dst: 真冰是一种用任何方法都无法融化或烧穿的物质。连 Dogun 魔法都没能在上面留下一点痕迹。
The Breaking Point#175.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#176.src: ... I imagine why this location was chosen to hold the elders. A prison from which they would never be able to escape.
The Breaking Point#176.dst: ……我想这就是为什么这里被选来关押长老们。一座他们永远无法逃出的监狱。
The Breaking Point#176.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#177.src: It is known for it to form naturally under extreme conditions... But the ice here is nowhere near natural.
The Breaking Point#177.dst: 据说它会在极端条件下自然形成……但这里的冰一点都不自然。
The Breaking Point#177.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#178.src: It was formed by an Ice Drake's Breath partway through the war- and, well, as you can see, it has remained here ever since.
The Breaking Point#178.dst: 它是在战争中途由冰飞龙的吐息造成的——然后，嗯，你也看到了，从那之后就一直留在这里。
The Breaking Point#178.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#179.src: Just another remnant of our past mistakes, I suppose...
The Breaking Point#179.dst: 我想，这不过是我们过去犯下的错误又一个遗迹……
The Breaking Point#179.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#180.src: Ahem. In any case- as I said, True Ice is impossible to break through, even with the most scorching flames.
The Breaking Point#180.dst: 咳咳。总之——就像我说的，真冰是无法突破的，就算用最炽烈的火焰也一样。
The Breaking Point#180.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#181.src: I... I suppose that a dragon's breath might be able to melt it. That logic does make sense.
The Breaking Point#181.dst: 我……我想龙的吐息也许能融化它。这个逻辑确实说得通。
The Breaking Point#181.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#182.src: We have little knowledge of what dragons were like, though. As they went extinct, that information became... useless. And so, it was lost.
The Breaking Point#182.dst: 不过我们对龙是什么样子几乎一无所知。龙灭绝之后，那些知识就变得……没用了。于是，就失传了。
The Breaking Point#182.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#183.src: If anyone would know more about dragons, it would be the doguns.
The Breaking Point#183.dst: 要说谁会更了解龙，那就是 Dogun 了。
The Breaking Point#183.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#184.src: But none of that matters. All the dragons are gone, after all. We still have no options.
The Breaking Point#184.dst: 但这些都不重要。毕竟所有的龙都不在了。我们还是无计可施。
The Breaking Point#184.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#185.src: Why, they died out. As Gavellian civilizations grew in size, the ferocity and size of a dragon was simply too much of a threat.
The Breaking Point#185.dst: 为什么，它们灭绝了啊。随着 Gavel 的文明越来越壮大，龙的凶猛和体型就成了太大的威胁。
The Breaking Point#185.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#186.src: Some were hunted. Some died of starvation. Eggs were taken from nests and shattered over boulders for the birds to feed on.
The Breaking Point#186.dst: 有些被猎杀。有些饿死了。蛋被人从巢里拿走，砸在巨石上给鸟吃。
The Breaking Point#186.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#187.src: Now all that are left are dragonlings - echoes of their once-great ancestors, with barely enough flames to singe your armor.
The Breaking Point#187.dst: 如今只剩下幼龙——它们曾经伟大的祖先的回响，火焰弱到几乎连你的盔甲都烧不焦。
The Breaking Point#187.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#189.src: A living dragon... You've done quite a lot, haven't you? Stopped a war, moved a dragon...
The Breaking Point#189.dst: 一条活着的龙……你做了不少事啊，是吧？阻止了一场战争，搬动了一条龙……
The Breaking Point#189.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#190.src: Well... if there is a living dragon at {p}... Then we still have hope! {u}, we must ask for its help.
The Breaking Point#190.dst: 好吧……如果 {p} 真的有一条活着的龙……那我们还有希望！{u}，我们必须请它帮忙。
The Breaking Point#190.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#191.src: Let us return to the others. I asked them to wait outside of {p}... perhaps they'll be able to confirm that a dragon's breath would do the job.
The Breaking Point#191.dst: 我们回去找其他人吧。我请他们在 {p} 外面等着……也许他们能确认龙的吐息是否管用。
The Breaking Point#191.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#192.src: Indeed. The fire dragons that sided with them during the war. I'm sure you've come across the skeleton just outside Freezing Heights?
The Breaking Point#192.dst: 没错。就是战争中站在他们那边的火龙。我想你应该在冰冻高地外面见过那副骨骸吧？
The Breaking Point#192.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#193.src: Yes, well... the Dwarves needed a counter to the sheer power of a fire dragon in battle, and so they resorted to enslaving dragons and drakes of other elements.
The Breaking Point#193.dst: 是啊，嗯……矮人需要能在战场上抗衡火龙那股纯粹力量的东西，于是他们奴役了其他元素的龙和飞龙。
The Breaking Point#193.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#194.src: Like the Ice Drake that created this vault, and encased the Elders in the truest of ice.
The Breaking Point#194.dst: 就像造出这座地窖、把长老们封进最纯粹的冰里的那条冰飞龙。
The Breaking Point#194.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#195.src: ... Well, there was this excellent novel of about one of those creatures from the Shiar, who had to travel to the Heights with this ring he had inherited-
The Breaking Point#195.dst: ……嗯，有一本很棒的小说，讲的是 Shiar 的其中一个那种小家伙，得带着一枚继承来的戒指前往高地——
The Breaking Point#195.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#196.src: But I confess, these questions seem almost irrelevant. We have a more pressing issue at hand, {u}.
The Breaking Point#196.dst: 不过我承认，这些问题几乎无关紧要。我们眼前有更紧迫的问题，{u}。
The Breaking Point#196.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#197.src: This ice is harder than obsidian itself. The crystals which form the material are bonded by ancient magic.
The Breaking Point#197.dst: 这冰比黑曜石本身还硬。构成它的晶体是由古老的魔法结合在一起的。
The Breaking Point#197.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#198.src: Shattering it with such tools isn't an option. Perhaps there is a weapon that could break through, somewhere deep in our armory- after all, this vault had to be carved somehow...
The Breaking Point#198.dst: 用那种工具把它敲碎是行不通的。也许我们军械库深处某个地方有能突破它的武器——毕竟这座地窖总得用什么东西凿出来……
The Breaking Point#198.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#199.src: However, given the circumstances, I don't think we have the time to search for it. Even if we started now, our armory is enormous. It would take weeks to find what we need.
The Breaking Point#199.dst: 不过，照目前的情况，我觉得我们没时间去找。就算现在开始找，我们的军械库大得惊人。要找到需要的东西得花上好几个星期。
The Breaking Point#199.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#200.src: The lava of the Heights is nothing more than molten rock. Just a remnant of the shaping of these caverns.
The Breaking Point#200.dst: 高地的熔岩不过是熔化的岩石。只是这些洞穴成形时留下的残余。
The Breaking Point#200.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#201.src: It's not nearly hot enough to melt True Ice. If it could, the Freezing Heights would have faded long ago.
The Breaking Point#201.dst: 它的温度远远不够融化真冰。要是可以的话，冰冻高地早就消失了。
The Breaking Point#201.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#202.src: My... uhm... green is nice, I suppose? Though perhaps not very Dwarven...
The Breaking Point#202.dst: 我的……呃……我想绿色挺不错的？虽然也许不太像矮人会喜欢的……
The Breaking Point#202.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#203.src: Red, then. Or orange! ...Although my bedsheets are the most wonderful shade of navy blue...
The Breaking Point#203.dst: 那就红色吧。或者橙色！……不过我的床单是最棒的那种海军蓝……
The Breaking Point#203.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#204.src: Breakfast... I had some eggs, I suppose. Though, I had no idea that breakfast would be my last, did I..?
The Breaking Point#204.dst: 早餐……我想我吃了几个蛋。不过，我怎么会知道那会是我最后一顿早餐呢……？
The Breaking Point#204.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#205.src: Hm... Had I known, maybe I would have chosen differently. Maybe I would have-... nevermind.
The Breaking Point#205.dst: 嗯……要是我早知道，也许会选别的吃。也许我会——……算了。
The Breaking Point#205.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#206.src: Regroup at outside {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to figure out how to free the Elders.
The Breaking Point#206.dst: 到 {p} 外面 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 重新集合，想办法解放长老们。

The Breaking Point#207.src: ... so this is the situation we find ourselves in. Paku, what do you think? Would such a plan work?
The Breaking Point#207.dst: ……这就是我们眼下的处境。Paku，你怎么看？这样的计划行得通吗？
The Breaking Point#207.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#208.src: Hm... You may be correct... Draani. The magic in... a dragon's breath... was very potent. And to think... mighty Ozoth had survived... all these years...
The Breaking Point#208.dst: 嗯……你也许说得对……Draani。龙的吐息中……蕴含的魔法……非常强大。没想到……伟大的 Ozoth……竟然活过了……这么多年……
The Breaking Point#208.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#209.src: If Ozoth is alive... we must seek her help. If the doguns ask... for her aid, she will... give it.
The Breaking Point#209.dst: 如果 Ozoth 还活着……我们就必须请她帮忙。如果是 Dogun……向她求援，她会……伸出援手。
The Breaking Point#209.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#210.src: Well, that's as good a plan as any. {u}, you'll travel to seek this dragon's counsel, along with... Ineos, was it? Good luck.
The Breaking Point#210.dst: 好吧，这计划跟其他计划一样好。{u}，你去寻求这条龙的指点，跟……Ineos 一起，是这个名字吧？祝你们好运。
The Breaking Point#210.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#211.src: You should... take the Trading Tunnel... {u}. I will put the coordinates... in your Quest Book.
The Breaking Point#211.dst: 你应该……走贸易隧道……{u}。我会把坐标……写进你的任务书。
The Breaking Point#211.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#212.src: Use the {p} trading tunnel at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to travel to {p}.

The Breaking Point#213.src: Travel to {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] in an attempt to speak with her.

The Breaking Point#214.src: Ah... it is... good to... see you. We must... proceed to Ozoth... with all haste.
The Breaking Point#214.dst: 啊……很……高兴……见到你。我们必须……尽快……前往 Ozoth 那里。
The Breaking Point#214.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#215.src: Ozoth the Dragon... Endless Kindler... we have come... to ask for your aid.
The Breaking Point#215.dst: 巨龙 Ozoth……无尽燃者……我们前来……请求你的援助。
The Breaking Point#215.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#217.src: We are searching... for a way... to melt the truest... of ice. The fate... of Gavel... hangs in the balance.
The Breaking Point#217.dst: 我们在寻找……融化……最纯粹的冰的……方法。Gavel 的……命运……悬于一线。
The Breaking Point#217.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#218.src: Doguns... and Dragons... our fates have been entwined... for centuries. We call on you now... Endless Kindler... to save this province.
The Breaking Point#218.dst: Dogun……与龙……我们的命运已经交织了……几百年。如今我们呼唤你……无尽燃者……拯救这个行省。
The Breaking Point#218.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#220.src: I... see. ... Ozoth tells me... that an Everflame... will free the Elders.
The Breaking Point#220.dst: 我……明白了。……Ozoth 告诉我……一团不熄之焰……就能解放长老们。
The Breaking Point#220.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#222.src: The Endless Kindler... is willing to part... with hers. You must... retrieve it... from her stomach.
The Breaking Point#222.dst: 无尽燃者……愿意把她的……分给我们。你必须……从她的胃里……把它取出来。
The Breaking Point#222.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#224.src: I would advise you... not to think... too much about this. When... you are ready... enter Ozoth's mouth and retrieve... the flame.
The Breaking Point#224.dst: 我建议你……别想得……太多。等……你准备好了……就进入 Ozoth 的嘴里……取回……火焰。
The Breaking Point#224.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#225.src: Descend into Ozoth's belly to retrieve an Everflame.
The Breaking Point#225.dst: 深入 Ozoth 的肚子，取回一团不熄之焰。

The Breaking Point#226.src: Travel to {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] with an Everflame.

The Breaking Point#227.src: {u}! Have you retrieved... the Eternal Flame?
The Breaking Point#227.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#228.src: Excellent. Endless Kindler... thank you... for your sacrifice. I will ensure... that your flame... is returned to you.
The Breaking Point#228.dst: 太好了。无尽燃者……感谢你……的牺牲。我会确保……你的火焰……回到你身边。
The Breaking Point#228.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#230.src: Ozoth apologises... if it was a bit hot... in there.
The Breaking Point#230.dst: Ozoth 为……里面……有点热……向你道歉。
The Breaking Point#230.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#231.src: Now, {u}... I was never the best... at the ancient magic... but I hope I have enough skill... to take us the short route back...
The Breaking Point#231.dst: 现在，{u}……我一向不是……最擅长……古老魔法的人……但我希望我的本事……足够带我们……走捷径回去……
The Breaking Point#231.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#232.src: You have returned! Is there news from {p}? Did the dragon offer aid?
The Breaking Point#232.dst: 你们回来了！{p} 那边有消息吗？龙愿意帮忙吗？
The Breaking Point#232.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#233.src: She did... Ozoth has made a great sacrifice... for this province... but we have an Eternal Flame... to melt the ice.
The Breaking Point#233.dst: 她愿意……Ozoth 为了……这个行省……做出了巨大的牺牲……但我们有了永恒之焰……可以融化冰了。
The Breaking Point#233.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#234.src: Well done... both of you. I will ensure... that the doguns thank her... properly. The dwarves would do well... to do the same.
The Breaking Point#234.dst: 干得好……你们两个。我会确保……Dogun 好好地……向她道谢。矮人……最好也……这么做。
The Breaking Point#234.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#235.src: Yes, yes, but there's no time to worry about that now. Quick, let's get back to the-
The Breaking Point#235.dst: 是，是，但现在没时间担心那个。快，我们赶回——
The Breaking Point#235.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#236.src: Be wary... of the Elders... Draani. It is unlikely they will react well... after their imprisonment. It is vital... you explain the situation... to them.
The Breaking Point#236.dst: 要小心……长老们……Draani。被囚禁了那么久……他们不太可能……有好脸色。你一定要……向他们……说明情况。
The Breaking Point#236.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#237.src: I would join you... both... but the ice is inhospitable... to my kind. I wish the both of you... the best of luck.
The Breaking Point#237.dst: 我很想……跟你们……一起去……但那冰对我的族类……很不友善。祝你们两个……好运。
The Breaking Point#237.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#238.src: ...right. Yes. Well, there's no getting around it. Come, {u}. We must unfreeze the elders and get them to listen to us. Bring the flame, I will meet you at the Vault.
The Breaking Point#238.dst: ……好吧。是啊。嗯，这是躲不掉的。来吧，{u}。我们得解冻长老们，让他们听我们说话。带上火焰，我在地窖跟你会合。
The Breaking Point#238.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#239.src: Return to the Dogun Vault at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to free the Dogun Elders.
The Breaking Point#239.dst: 回到 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Dogun 地窖，解放 Dogun 长老们。

The Breaking Point#240.src: Well then, what are we waiting for! Let's free these elders, shall we?
The Breaking Point#240.dst: 那么，我们还等什么！来解放这些长老吧，好吗？
The Breaking Point#240.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#241.src: Just bring the Everflame to each of the cells, and melt through that True Ice.
The Breaking Point#241.dst: 只要把不熄之焰带到每一间囚室，融穿那些真冰就行。
The Breaking Point#241.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#242.src: Excellent! We've done it! Now we just need to explain the situation-...
The Breaking Point#242.dst: 太好了！我们做到了！现在我们只需要说明情况——……
The Breaking Point#242.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#244.src: ...Ah. I suppose I did not... think this through. Ehm. Elders, I must apo-
The Breaking Point#244.dst: ……啊。看来我没有……想清楚。呃。长老们，我必须道——
The Breaking Point#244.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#245.src: Dwarf... Hm. The crimes... of your ancestors... must be repaid.
The Breaking Point#245.dst: 矮人……嗯。你们祖先的……罪行……必须偿还。
The Breaking Point#245.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#246.src: However. We have... heard you speak. We have... learned of... the Protector's state.
The Breaking Point#246.dst: 不过。我们……听到你说的了。我们已经……得知……守护者的状况。
The Breaking Point#246.speaker: Elder Desint

The Breaking Point#247.src: We will... settle your debt... later. This situation... is a more pressing... concern. The Protector... must be calmed.
The Breaking Point#247.dst: 你们的债……我们晚点……再算。眼前的情况……更加……紧迫。守护者……必须被平息。
The Breaking Point#247.speaker: Elder Iscor

The Breaking Point#248.src: ...Yes. You. Human. That was... dragonfire... was it not?
The Breaking Point#248.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#249.src: Then allow me... to borrow it. Its strength... will allow us... to restore ours. Now... Who now holds... the title... of Chieftain?
The Breaking Point#249.dst: 那么就让我……借用它。它的力量……能让我们……恢复我们的力量。现在……谁如今……担任……酋长？
The Breaking Point#249.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#250.src: A-ah! Paku is now the Dogun Chieftain. He would be at... At Taloka.
The Breaking Point#250.dst: 啊、啊！Paku 现在是 Dogun 酋长。他应该在……在 Taloka。
The Breaking Point#250.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#251.src: Very well... We shall travel... through flame... and through stone...
The Breaking Point#251.dst: 很好……我们就……穿过火焰……穿过岩石……出发吧……
The Breaking Point#251.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#252.src: ...The Elders... after all this time... to see you, again... in the flesh...
The Breaking Point#252.dst: ……长老们……过了这么久……又能……亲眼……见到你们……
The Breaking Point#252.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#253.src: Greetings, Paku. We have much... to discuss. But first... we must travel... to the Protector.
The Breaking Point#253.dst: 你好，Paku。我们有很多……要谈。但首先……我们必须……前往守护者那里。
The Breaking Point#253.speaker: Elder Desint

The Breaking Point#254.src: Join us... Ineos and Paku. There is... very little time... to waste.
The Breaking Point#254.dst: 加入我们吧……Ineos 和 Paku。我们……几乎没有……时间可以浪费。
The Breaking Point#254.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#255.src: Now, let us travel... (The following part of the line is High Gavellian) Through flame... and through stone...
The Breaking Point#255.dst: 现在，让我们出发……(接下来这段台词是高等 Gavel 语) 穿过火焰……穿过岩石……
The Breaking Point#255.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#256.src: Korzim... my son... join us. The Elders must see... to the Protector.
The Breaking Point#256.dst: Korzim……我的儿子……跟我们来。长老们必须去……照看守护者。
The Breaking Point#256.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#257.src: Iscor... Astal... Desint... it has been... too long. I will come.
The Breaking Point#257.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#258.src: Earth and flame... fire and stone... transport us through your form! (In High Gavellian)
The Breaking Point#258.dst: 大地与火焰……烈焰与岩石……以你们的形体载我们前行！(高等 Gavel 语)
The Breaking Point#258.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#260.src: There's no time! I can feel the damned ground cracking beneath my feet, we have to turn to the final option. We've had demolition mages on standby the past few days, our only choice is to-
The Breaking Point#260.dst: 没时间了！我都能感觉到这该死的地面在脚下裂开，我们只能采取最后手段。这几天我们一直让爆破法师待命，我们唯一的选择就是——
The Breaking Point#260.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#261.src: Rhay. Elix. My Elders... have been freed. They are here... to help... the Protector.
The Breaking Point#261.dst: Rhay。Elix。我的长老们……已经获得解放。他们来这里……是为了帮助……守护者。
The Breaking Point#261.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#262.src: Join us... brave ones. You will see... that your efforts to save this Province... have not been in vain.
The Breaking Point#262.dst: 加入我们吧……勇敢的人们。你们会看到……你们为拯救这个行省所做的努力……并没有白费。
The Breaking Point#262.speaker: Elder Iscor

The Breaking Point#263.src: Flames of the earth... take us to the Great Protector... to make our plea! (In High Gavellian)
The Breaking Point#263.dst: 大地之焰……带我们去见伟大的守护者……献上我们的恳求！(高等 Gavel 语)
The Breaking Point#263.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#264.src: Travel to the Canyon Colossus at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to attempt to calm it.
The Breaking Point#264.dst: 前往 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的峡谷巨像，试着平息它。

The Breaking Point#265.dst: 伟大的守护者……它愤怒至极。
The Breaking Point#265.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#266.src: Hmph. Foolish dwarves... This is what has come...of your needless war... You are fortunate...to have freed us now...
The Breaking Point#266.dst: 哼。愚蠢的矮人……这就是……你们无谓的战争……带来的后果……你们很幸运……现在就解放了我们……
The Breaking Point#266.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#267.src: Desint... Iscor... I will prepare... the ritual. Defend me... as I do so.
The Breaking Point#267.dst: Desint……Iscor……我来准备……仪式。在我准备的时候……保护我。
The Breaking Point#267.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#268.src: Human. We will pull the Protector... away from the brink. That is all we can do now. All the power... we can muster.
The Breaking Point#268.dst: 人类。我们会把守护者……从边缘拉回来。这就是我们现在能做的全部。我们……能凝聚的……所有力量。
The Breaking Point#268.speaker: Elder Desint

The Breaking Point#269.src: You must enter... these sacred grounds. Battle through it to the end... Knock some sense... into it.
The Breaking Point#269.dst: 你必须进入……这片圣地。一路战斗到尽头……把它……打醒。
The Breaking Point#269.speaker: Elder Iscor

The Breaking Point#270.src: Adventurer... We are counting...on you. We will try to...support you however we can.
The Breaking Point#270.dst: 冒险者……我们就靠……你了。我们会尽力……支援你。
The Breaking Point#270.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#271.src: We'll do the best we can out here! I have some ideas already...
The Breaking Point#271.dst: 我们会在外面尽力而为！我已经有一些点子了……
The Breaking Point#271.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#272.src: Rhay, this isn't the time. Human. We have your back. You can do this.
The Breaking Point#272.dst: Rhay，现在不是时候。人类。我们会支援你。你做得到的。
The Breaking Point#272.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#273.src: You have faced...worse odds before...have you not? You will face them...again.
The Breaking Point#273.dst: 你以前……面对过……更糟的局面……不是吗？你会……再次面对它们。
The Breaking Point#273.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#274.src: It is done. Desint... Iscor... Take your postions. We must... hold it back.
The Breaking Point#274.dst: 完成了。Desint……Iscor……各就各位。我们必须……挡住它。
The Breaking Point#274.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#275.src: Great Protector, lord of stone, hear our burning call. Your fury clouds your vision, your anger burns and twists our home. (In High Gavellian)
The Breaking Point#275.dst: 伟大的守护者，岩石之主，请听我们炽热的呼唤。你的怒火蒙蔽了你的视线，你的愤怒灼烧并扭曲了我们的家园。(高等 Gavel 语)
The Breaking Point#275.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#276.src: We, the doguns, who now hold the final flame of a fallen god... We will hold you back. We will keep this land intact! (In High Gavellian)
The Breaking Point#276.dst: 我们，Dogun，如今握着一位陨落之神的最后火焰……我们会挡住你。我们会保住这片土地！(高等 Gavel 语)
The Breaking Point#276.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#277.src: We will... hold it from here... human. Now... go! We will not... be able to hold it... for long...
The Breaking Point#277.dst: 我们会……在这里……挡住它……人类。现在……去吧！我们……撑不了……多久……
The Breaking Point#277.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#278.src: This crystal...will let you harness...our flame. Use it...to break through...its defenses.
The Breaking Point#278.dst: 这块水晶……能让你驾驭……我们的火焰。用它……突破……它的防御。
The Breaking Point#278.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#279.src: ... Before you go. I will offer you... these powerful relics. Our people... have held them for... longer than I have lived. They may... help you on your quest.
The Breaking Point#279.dst: ……在你出发之前。我要把……这些强大的遗物……交给你。我们的族人……保管它们的时间……比我活着的岁月……还长。它们也许……能在你的任务中……帮上忙。
The Breaking Point#279.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#280.src: I cannot give you something as unique as what Paku has offered, but I can still lend you a sum from our treasury. Use it as you must, so long as you can calm that thing. Good luck.
The Breaking Point#280.dst: 我给不了你像 Paku 那样独一无二的东西，但我还是能从国库借你一笔钱。只要能平息那东西，怎么用都行。祝你好运。
The Breaking Point#280.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#000~1.src: Hey, keep up! We need to get this part into the machine as quickly as we can!
The Breaking Point#000~1.dst: 喂，跟上！我们得尽快把这个零件装进机器里！

The Breaking Point#001~1.src: Amazing work! I'll get us back to Kandon Beda with that capacitor as quick as possible.
The Breaking Point#001~1.dst: 太棒了！我会尽快带着那个电容器把我们送回 Kandon Beda。

The Breaking Point#002~1.src: I... see. {u}... Ozoth tells me... that an Everflame... will free the Elders.
The Breaking Point#002~1.dst: 我……明白了。{u}……Ozoth 告诉我……一团不熄之焰……就能解放长老们。

similar.text: I... see. ... Ozoth tells me... that an Everflame... will free the Elders.

The Breaking Point#003~1.src: You need to get onto the path up to {p}. There should be signposts outside of {p}...
The Breaking Point#003~1.dst: 你需要找到通往 {p} 的路。{p} 外面应该有路标……

The Breaking Point#039~1.src: Right, right. Don't mind me, I'm just a little on edge, for... well, for obvious reasons. Just hop aboard.
The Breaking Point#039~1.dst: 好、好。别在意我，我只是有点紧张，因为……嗯，原因很明显。上来吧。
The Breaking Point#039~1.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#042~1.src: Well, there it is! The Canyon Colossus itself. The source of all of our problems here at {p}.
The Breaking Point#042~1.dst: 看，就在那里！峡谷巨像本尊。我们在 {p} 这里所有问题的根源。
The Breaking Point#042~1.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#053~1.src: This thing is ancient, and we don't know how it works. The best we can do is try and keep it from reaching its breaking point, and prevent the canyon from meeting the same fate as the {p}.
The Breaking Point#053~1.dst: 这东西非常古老，我们也不知道它是怎么运作的。我们最多只能设法不让它到达临界点，别让峡谷落得跟 {p} 一样的下场。
The Breaking Point#053~1.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#056~1.src: Our council agreed, and we got to work designing a machine that could replicate the dogun magic that pacified the Colossus long ago.
The Breaking Point#056~1.dst: 我们的议会同意了，于是我们开始设计一台机器，想复制很久以前让巨像平静下来的 Dogun 魔法。
The Breaking Point#056~1.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#072~1.src: Okay, right, back to the question - what are you two doing here already? There's another few days or so until our next routine maintenance, isn't there?
The Breaking Point#072~1.dst: 好，对，回到问题：你们两个怎么这么快就来了？离下一次例行维护不是还有几天吗？
The Breaking Point#072~1.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#077~1.src: Right! Right. Got a little distracted there... Uh, we've run into a problem back at {p}. We experienced an unexpected seismic event, and the device was heavily damaged.
The Breaking Point#077~1.dst: 对！对。刚刚有点走神……呃，我们在 {p} 那边遇上了问题。我们碰上了一次意料之外的地震，装置严重受损。
The Breaking Point#077~1.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#120~1.src: It looks like Ozoth's body is trying to prevent you from getting the Everflame!
The Breaking Point#120~1.dst: 看来 Ozoth 的身体在阻止你拿到不熄之焰！

The Breaking Point#147~1.src: Yes. We have been... hard at work... these past weeks. Taloka will soon... stand once more. And many... of our sealed brethren... have been returned to life.
The Breaking Point#147~1.dst: 是的。这几个星期……我们一直……在努力。Taloka 很快……就会重新矗立。而我们许多……被封印的同胞……也已经重获新生。
The Breaking Point#147~1.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#149~1.src: You use the grappling hook to swing back to the King in a dazzling feat of trapeze consisting of mid-air flips and acrobatic flourishes.
The Breaking Point#149~1.dst: 你用抓钩荡回国王身边，在半空中翻腾、秀出各种杂技花招，上演了一场令人眼花缭乱的空中飞人绝技。

The Breaking Point#152~1.src: The situation... is dire. The Great Protector... has been left alone... for far too long. We need... the wisdom... of our Elders. Do you know... where they are sealed?
The Breaking Point#152~1.dst: 情况……危急。伟大的守护者……被独自留下……太久了。我们需要……长老们的……智慧。你知道……他们被封印在……哪里吗？
The Breaking Point#152~1.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#173~1.src: Hm. That... didn't work. This magic is old, and I never took the time to learn it properly... Alright. We have alternatives.
The Breaking Point#173~1.dst: 唔。那……没用。这魔法很古老，我从来没花时间好好学过……好吧。我们还有别的办法。
The Breaking Point#173~1.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#174~1.src: If my memory serves correctly, there should be a manual override on the other end of this chasm.
The Breaking Point#174~1.dst: 如果我没记错，这道深渊的另一头应该有个手动控制开关。
The Breaking Point#174~1.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#226~1.src: ... so that is the situation we find ourselves in. Paku, what do you think? Would such a plan work?
The Breaking Point#226~1.dst: ……我们的处境就是这样。Paku，你怎么看？这样的计划行得通吗？
The Breaking Point#226~1.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#254~1.src: She did... Ozoth has made a great sacrifice... for this province... but we have an Everflame... to melt the ice.
The Breaking Point#254~1.dst: 她愿意……Ozoth 为这个行省……做出了巨大的牺牲……但我们拿到了不熄之焰……可以融化那些冰了。
The Breaking Point#254~1.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#260~1.src: ... right. Yes. Well, there's no getting around it. Come, {u}. We must unfreeze the Elders and get them to listen to us. Bring the flame, I will meet you at the Vault.
The Breaking Point#260~1.dst: ……好吧。是的。嗯，这是躲不掉的。来吧，{u}。我们得把长老们解冻，让他们听我们说话。把火焰带上，我在地窖等你。
The Breaking Point#260~1.speaker: King Draani
